system.description:
A bone wand carved with various animals' eyes and ears.

Benefit. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.spells.Item.ItoZZ0nli29N5d7G]{blind/deafen} spell with this wand (DC 12 spellcasting check). On a failure, you can't use this wand again until you successfully rest.

On a critical failure, the wand breaks permanently and you must roll a mishap if you are subject to them.
